label: Source HubDB table
name: source_table
help_text: Use a table of people, clients, names, or media outlets. Rows can include a related logo/source row, or stand alone for logo-only sliders.

label: HubDB query
name: hubdb_query
help_text: Optional HubDB query string, for example category__contains=featured_twic_guests&orderBy=sort_order. Leave blank to use all table rows.

label: Ordered row IDs
name: ordered_row_ids
help_text: Optional HubDB row IDs separated by commas, spaces, or new lines. These rows render first in this order, followed by the remaining rows from the HubDB query.

label: Item limit
name: max_items
help_text: Only used when Items to show is set to Limit items.

children.label: Link source
children.name: mode
children.help_text: Use a URL column, generate a blog tag archive URL, or disable primary links.

children.label: Blog tag base URL
children.name: blog_tag_base_url
children.help_text: Used when Link source is Blog tag archive. Example: /this-week-in-cleantech-podcast/tag/

children.label: Slug override column
children.name: tag_slug_column
children.help_text: Optional HubDB column containing the exact slug. If blank or empty for a row, the slug is generated dynamically.

children.label: Slug source column
children.name: tag_slug_source_column
children.help_text: HubDB column used to generate the slug when no exact slug is provided. Leave blank to use the primary name column.

children.label: Validate tag archive links
children.name: validate_blog_tag_links
children.help_text: When enabled, primary and related tag archive links only render if the configured blog has posts for that tag.

children.label: Link source
children.name: mode
children.help_text: Use a URL column, generate a blog tag archive URL, or disable related source links.

children.label: Blog tag base URL
children.name: blog_tag_base_url
children.help_text: Used when Link source is Blog tag archive. Example: /this-week-in-cleantech-podcast/tag/

children.label: Slug override column
children.name: tag_slug_column
children.help_text: Optional HubDB column on the related source row containing the exact slug. If blank or empty for a row, the slug is generated dynamically.

children.label: Slug source column
children.name: tag_slug_source_column
children.help_text: Related source row column used to generate the slug when no exact slug is provided. Leave blank to use the related source name column.

children.label: Primary detail column
children.name: primary_detail
children.help_text: Optional title, role, client, or descriptor column on each primary row.

children.label: Primary URL column
children.name: primary_url
children.help_text: Optional URL column on each primary row.

children.label: Related source column
children.name: related_source
children.help_text: Optional relation column for a client, media outlet, logo, or other source row.

children.label: Related source name column
children.name: related_source_name
children.help_text: Name column on the related source row.

children.label: Related source logo column
children.name: related_source_logo
children.help_text: Logo or image column on the related source row.

children.label: Related source URL column
children.name: related_source_url
children.help_text: Optional URL column on the related source row.

children.label: Animation speed
children.name: duration
children.help_text: Approximate movement speed. 0 stops automatic movement; 80 is medium; higher numbers move faster.
